name: WebCompass
abstract: WebCompass unifies evaluation for web generation, editing, and repair. This page uses the Overall score from the main table.
method: This work unifies web coding into generation, editing, and repair tasks, and jointly evaluates runnability, spec implementation, design quality, and interaction repair.
It uses real-browser execution and an agent-as-a-judge protocol to assess front-end development ability.
The main results show a clear lead for top closed-source systems, while open-source models still lag on complex multi-page and interactive tasks.

metrics.name: Overall
metrics.note: Overall mean score across generation, editing, and repair dimensions.

leaderboard_note: The leaderboard uses the Overall column from the main results table, which averages the nine fine-grained dimensions.
